items.title: R1 window 2: back office and product fixes
items.problem: Product editing is slow and error-prone for back-office staff, and a few product screens still load the whole catalog.
items.impact: Staff re-key prices, and big catalogs make pickers feel frozen.
items.solution: Ship inline price editing, box/piece rollover, lighter pickers and the tenant settings search together as one release.

items.title: R2 counter sales and order screen
items.problem: Shops with a counter cannot ring up a walk-in sale and take payment on one screen.
items.impact: Counter customers still need a separate order and invoice, which slows the queue.
items.solution: Add the walk-in flow, pay on the same screen, and a faster order editor.

items.title: R3 billing go-live
items.problem: Subscriptions are not yet billed automatically from the first of the month.
items.impact: Invoices for new businesses are made by hand and can be late or wrong.
items.solution: Prorate the first invoice, charge in advance, and move unpaid accounts to read-only after a 7-day grace period.

items.title: Product page: inline price editing
items.problem: Changing a product price means opening a separate form and saving, one field at a time.
items.impact: Staff lose minutes on every price update, and typos slip in when many prices change at once.
items.solution: Let staff edit prices directly in the product table, with one shared editor so every screen behaves the same.

items.title: Floating editor as the one price editor
items.problem: Price editing has two different editors that behave differently.
items.impact: People get surprising results depending on where they edit, which erodes trust in the numbers.
items.solution: Make the floating editor the single price editor and remove the old one. It is in review now.

items.title: Units: box and piece rollover on edit
items.problem: Editing boxes and pieces together can leave a line with 12 pieces instead of 1 box and 0 pieces.
items.impact: Customers can be charged the wrong amount on boxed products.
items.solution: Roll pieces over into boxes automatically whenever a quantity is edited, using the shared money rules.

items.title: Inventory picker without whole-catalog fetch
items.problem: The inventory picker downloaded the whole product catalog each time it opened.
items.impact: Large businesses waited several seconds before they could pick a product.
items.solution: Load only the products being searched. This is live now.

items.title: Back office: tenant settings search
items.problem: Finding a setting in the back office means clicking through every tab.
items.impact: New businesses struggle to set themselves up and ask support for help.
items.solution: Add a search box that jumps straight to the setting.

items.title: Counter sales: walk-in customer flow
items.problem: A shop cannot sell to a walk-in customer without first creating a customer record.
items.impact: Counter sales are slow and customers walk away from long lines.
items.solution: Let staff sell to a generic walk-in customer and add details later if needed.
items.ownerAsk: Please confirm how cash totals should be rounded (see the question about cash rounding).

items.title: Pay on the same screen

blocked.by: OQ-N2 owner ruling on cash rounding

items.problem: After a counter sale the cashier has to leave the order and open the invoice to take payment.
items.impact: Extra steps at the till; some sales are left unpaid by mistake.
items.solution: Show the payment buttons on the same screen as the order.

items.title: Order screen redesign: line editing
items.problem: The order screen is crowded, and editing a line is easy to get wrong.
items.impact: Orders contain mistakes that need correcting later.
items.solution: Redesign line editing so quantity, price and units are clear and checked as you type.

items.title: Billing: prorate first invoice
items.problem: A new business that starts mid-month gets a full month invoice.
items.impact: Customers complain about being overcharged, and we refund by hand.
items.solution: Charge only for the days left in the first month.

items.title: Ops monitor: server and UI
items.problem: Nobody can see one accurate picture of what is being built, what is stuck and what is next.
items.impact: The owner and the lanes spend time asking each other, and work gets dropped.
items.solution: This ops monitor: a live board built from the registers, pull requests and deploys.

items.title: Statement export for Acme Foods retailer accounts
items.problem: Retailer accounts cannot get a statement of what they owe.
items.impact: Customers call to ask for balances, which takes staff time.
items.solution: Add a statement export per account.

items.title: Owner: choose cash rounding rule for counter sales
items.problem: Counter sales in cash need a rule for rounding to the nearest coin.
items.impact: Until it is decided, the pay-on-same-screen work cannot finish and totals may differ by a few cents.
items.solution: Pick one rule and apply it everywhere. The team recommends rounding to the nearest 5 cents.

items.title: Owner: approve prod migration sitting
items.problem: Database changes for the next release can only go to production with your approval.
items.impact: The release cannot go live until the change is applied.
items.solution: Approve a short sitting where the team applies it with a fresh backup.

items.title: Login throttle spike on staging probe
items.problem: Sign-in attempts spiked on the staging probe and the login limiter started refusing real users.
items.impact: Staff at test businesses were locked out of signing in for several minutes.
items.solution: Raise the limit for the probe address and add an alert so we see it before users do.

items.title: Unit price shows stale value after edit
items.problem: After editing a unit price, the old price still shows until the page is refreshed.
items.impact: Staff think the change did not save and enter it twice.
items.solution: Refresh the displayed price from the saved value right after each edit.

items.title: Owner: allow card-only plan pick at signup
items.problem: Plan pick could be card-only.
items.impact: The release cannot go live until the change is applied.
items.solution: Approve a short sitting where the team applies it with a fresh backup.
